gloss: sutra chanting; reading of Buddhist scriptures

definitions.gloss: sutra chanting; reading of Buddhist scriptures aloud
definitions.explanation: The practice of chanting or reading Buddhist sutras aloud, typically performed by monks during religious ceremonies, funerals, and memorial services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{僧侶|そうりょ}→僧侶：11529_souryo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{読経|どきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
⟦{葬儀|そうぎ}→葬儀：15337_sougi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{読経|どきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{響|ひび}いた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: The sound of sutra chanting echoed at the funeral.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{仏壇|ぶつだん}→仏壇：07116_butsudan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{読経|どきょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日課|にっか}→日課：00317_nikka⟧だった。
examples.english: It was my grandmother's daily routine to chant sutras in front of the Buddhist altar every morning.

notes:
A word most Japanese people encounter in the context of funerals and memorial services, which are predominantly Buddhist in Japan. Even people who are not particularly religious are familiar with {読経|どきょう} as part of funeral rites.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {読経|どきょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to chant sutras
- {読経|どきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: the sound/voice of sutra chanting
- {読経|どきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: the sutra chanting begins
- {読経|どきょう}⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧: payment for sutra chanting services

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{経文|きょうもん}→経文：24001_kyoumon⟧: sutra text
- {般若心経|はんにゃしんぎょう}: Heart Sutra — one of the most commonly chanted sutras
- ⟦{念仏|ねんぶつ}→念仏：12850_nenbutsu⟧: nembutsu, chanting the name of Amida Buddha
- ⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧: Buddhist memorial service

USAGE:
Do not confuse with the homophone ⟦{度胸|どきょう}→度胸：15903_dokyou⟧ (courage, nerve).
